resources.name: Lut Presets
resources.author: ov-studio
resources.tagline: A curated collection of color grading LUT presets
resources.description:
Lut is a curated pack of 63 color grading presets, organized into
five collections: Cinematic, Moody, Portrait, ColorBoost, and
Lutify — covering everything from film-inspired tones to punchy
color boosts and natural skin-tone shaping.

Apply, swap, or reset LUTs on the fly through simple exported APIs,
making it easy to wire up your own menu or let other resources control grading directly.

Exports:
• `util.export.call("lut_presets", "get_list")` — Returns all preset paths.
• `util.export.call("lut_presets", "get_lut")` — Returns active preset index, or `false`.
• `util.export.call("lut_presets", "set_lut", index)` — Applies preset by index.
• `util.export.call("lut_presets", "reset_lut")` — Clears the active LUT.

Commands:
• `/lut <index>` — Applies preset by index from the console.

resources.name: Runcode
resources.author: ov-studio
resources.tagline: Execute Lua code directly from the console
resources.description:
Runcode is a lightweight runtime code executor that works on both
the client and the server.

Type `run <code>` into the console to compile and execute arbitrary
Lua on the fly — no need to reload scripts or restart. Both
expressions and statements are supported, and results (or errors)
are printed straight back to you, formatted and easy to read.

Perfect for quick debugging, prototyping, and live tweaks, whether
you're working client-side or server-side.
